What This Shows

This is a traffic simulation for Lake View. Each dot is a sampled car trip moving through the road network during a simulated day.

Where The Data Comes From

  • Roads come from OpenStreetMap.
  • Trips come from CMAP regional travel model data.
  • Traffic checks use City of Chicago traffic count data.

How To Read It

Dot colors show vehicle speed. Red and orange areas are where traffic is slow or stuck. The counters show how many simulated trips are active, completed, or lost.

Why It Helps

The model lets us test street changes before building them, such as bike lanes, road diets, traffic-flow changes, or user-drawn rough-pavement scenarios.

This is a planning tool, not a live traffic feed. Results improve as the model is calibrated.
